mapper.insert: INSERT INTO follows (follower_id, followee_id, created_at) VALUES ( #{followerId}, #{followeeId}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS VARCHAR)) )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM follows WHERE follower_id = #{followerId} AND followee_id = #{followeeId}
mapper.select:

FROM follows f JOIN users u ON u.id = f.followee_id WHERE f.follower_id = #{userId} ORDER BY u.username ASC
